comparison.objective: Tighten a nylon-insert locknut in a slot that permits only a 44-degree wrench swing.
comparison.physical_skill: Seat an open-end wrench, make repeated short strokes, flip or reindex it between bites, and overcome nut drag.
comparison.success_condition: Nut rotated up to 178 degrees and seated for one second, with partial credit based on net tightening angle.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record by hardware, but it tests repeated wrench reindexing on one nut; the candidate tests preserving a separately adjusted screw with a coaxial driver while locking a jam nut, followed by retained-motion cycles.
